title: Euro Segway - Simply The Best!
text: Fantastic 3 hours tour of the city with Phil. His knowledge of the city was incredible and his passion for the history of Barcelona was infectious. Loved the old photos he’d take out and reference to the old and new. Been on 3 Euro Segway tours in different cities and have to say the are by far the best company for and Segway tour!!!
author: Darren-7

title: Great day do it!!
text:
Start point easy to find tickets easy to Download.
Phillip was absolutely brilliant! Full of knowledge, looked after us so well.  We felt completely safe on The Segway and at every step of the way Phillip made sure we were ok and gave us plentiful of opportunities to take pics and ask questions.  I would recommend him to everyone- I’m 58 and my partner is 70 .
author: Sharon_D

title: A ‘MUST DO’ WHILST IN LISBON!
text: What can I say. David the owner, was absolutely brilliant! Had a pre trip on how to handle, slow down and manoeuvre, the Segway. The passion David shows during the tour is awe inspiring and we visited numerous areas of historical significance and views to take your breath away. It is a MUST if you are visiting Lisbon. See you next year David
author: Darren-7

title: Segway Tour
text: This was the highlight of our vacation.  Pablo did a quick, effective tutorial on the use of the Segway and off we went!  We had a great time riding along the coast and through town.  Pablo  had one of the best history reviews of all of our tours while in Barcelona!  Don't miss this adventure!
author: John_C

title: Great experience, recommended for all !
text: We all thoroughly enjoyed this experience and the boys who took us round were fantastic. We learnt so much about Barcelona that I don’t think we’d have found out on our own. Would definitely recommend.
author: Lorna_D

title: fun way to see Barcelona
text: We had a great time. The tour guide, Pablo, was engaging and informative. It was a fun way to see Barcelona.
author: Rob_H

title: Segways are Fun, Arash was great guide
text: Super fun way to get around Budapest and see the sight, our guide Arash was fantastic, lotsa if great hits of knowledge for each stop. Segways are super fun and easy to get around on. If you want little morsels of some good places to see around Budapest it's well worth doing. 100% recommend
author: VanRizzel

title: Great way to see Barcelona!
text: I booked a Barcelona City Highlights Segway Tour in March 2024. It was a 2-hour tour and I thoroughly enjoyed seeing Barcelona this way!  I was remiss in writing down my guide’s name but he was from Columbia and spoke amazing English and REALLY knew Barcelona!  Even though I didn’t book a private tour, I was the only one to sign up and he happily gave me a private tour anyway!  He assisted getting on and off the Segway to ensure I was safe and we saw so many locations, I can’t even list them all here!  I would HIGHLY recommend this tour AND my guide! author: LauraG44444

title: Great way to see the sights of Barcelona!
text: A fantastic way to get to see some of the sights of Barcelona! Quick but thorough training and guided throughout the tour! Highly recommended!!!
author: Stephen R

title: This is awesome - You must book this!
text: The whole experience was excellent - Nunu our guide was excellent + I thought the whole operation was very well run. Brilliant way to see the city and so much good fun!
author: Gemma_D
